methodology.summary: Initial fee and incentive map. It records quoted charges, contractual caps, observed token mechanics and gaps separately; it does not calculate an all-in cost, a score, or a legal conclusion.
methodology.scopeRule: A product example is not applied to another product. Missing amountText and payment are null, not zero. Actor alignment and tradeoff text is identified analysis unless a source says otherwise.

profiles.name: Ondo Global Markets
profiles.summary: Quoted pricing can include an issuer-retained spread and fees; the published pricing method is variable rather than a fixed basis-point schedule.

fees.label: Quoted price spread and issuer fees
fees.payer: Investor through the quoted transaction price
fees.payee: Issuer retains the quoted spread and fees
fees.note: Variable with quote size, target profit, inventory and proprietary pricing inputs; no fixed bps is recorded.

fees.label: Issuer sale quote spread
fees.payer: Investor through the quoted sale price
fees.payee: Issuer retains the price difference and fees
fees.note: A sale quote may differ from the underlying execution price. A purchaser-fee cap is not an all-in spread ceiling.

fees.label: Purchaser issuance-fee cap in reviewed sales terms
fees.note: A contractual maximum from the review dated 2026-09-17, not a current all-in quote.

fees.label: Purchaser redemption-fee cap in reviewed sales terms
fees.note: A contractual maximum from the review dated 2026-09-17, not a current all-in quote.

fees.label: Network transaction costs
fees.note: The issuer states that investors pay their network costs. This is not issuer revenue; no transaction-specific amount or allocation is recorded.

fees.label: Secondary venue charges
fees.note: Venues may charge separately; no venue or amount is recorded here.

fees.label: Issuer-stated US-company dividend withholding
fees.amountText: 30% of applicable dividends, not of the investment
fees.payer: BVI issuer on dividends received; holder exposure reflects net reinvestment
fees.payee: Tax authority through the withholding chain
fees.note: Not an issuer fee or a statement of the token holder's own tax liability. Fixed-income distributions can have exemptions; ADRs and other assets can differ.

actors.name: Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited
actors.payment: Retains quoted spread and fees where included in pricing
actors.alignment: Analysis, not an intent claim: transaction margin can support the issuer's business while a holder may seek the cheapest execution.
actors.tradeoff: The pricing inputs are not a published fixed fee schedule.

actors.name: Regulated broker-dealers
actors.alignment: Analysis: custody and execution arrangements are relevant to the quoted price path.
actors.tradeoff: Actual payment allocation is not identified in this fee review.

actors.name: Ankura Trust Company, LLC
actors.alignment: Analysis, not an intent claim: security enforcement and issuer pricing are distinct roles.
actors.tradeoff: Its compensation is not identified here.

actors.name: Secondary venues (not identified)
actors.alignment: Analysis: venue fees can add to holder cost.
actors.tradeoff: No venue-specific fee evidence is recorded.

gaps: No fixed issuer spread or all-in cost is confirmed.
No payment allocation for named intermediaries is confirmed.
This is not a fresh legal-rights review.

profiles.name: Kraken xStocks
profiles.summary: TSLAx has a dated product-page example; it must not be generalized to other xStocks. Programme documents state higher possible caps, not current charges.

fees.label: TSLAx management fee stated on product page
fees.payee: Issuer if a fee is introduced
fees.note: Issuer-published claim on a page last updated 2025-06-30, checked 2026-09-22; not an independently measured deduction or a promise of zero future fees.

fees.label: TSLAx future management-fee allowance
fees.note: Product-page allowance, not a current charge; read the governing Final Terms.

fees.label: Programme issuance-fee cap
fees.amountText: up to 5% of underlying market price
fees.note: Broader programme permission, not an additional fee to add to the product-specific cap and not a current quote.

fees.label: Programme redemption-fee cap
fees.amountText: up to 5% of underlying market price
fees.note: Broader programme permission, not an additional fee to add to the product-specific cap and not a current quote.

fees.label: Programme management-fee cap
fees.note: Permitted programme cap, not recorded as a current charge.

fees.label: Wind-down service costs
fees.note: Service costs rank before holder distributions; no rate is recorded.

actors.name: Backed Assets (JE) Ltd
actors.payment: Issuer fee recipient where a fee is charged
actors.alignment: Analysis, not an intent claim: transaction charges and any future AUM-based management fee can support issuer operations while a holder may seek cheaper execution.
actors.tradeoff: A cap does not establish a current charge.

actors.name: Parent and parent investors
actors.payment: Funding support; return arrangements not established
actors.basis: The reviewed prospectus described the issuer as not profitable and dependent on capital and financing from its parent and the parent's investors.
actors.alignment: Analysis: continuity may depend on sponsor support as well as fee income. A low current fee does not by itself establish a self-sustaining business model.
actors.tradeoff: This dated disclosure does not establish today's profitability, cash runway or a binding promise of future support.

actors.name: Alpaca Securities LLC
actors.alignment: Analysis: permitted securities lending introduces another economic relationship, whose benefit to token holders cannot be assessed without the revenue allocation.
actors.tradeoff: Lending is subject to Final Terms. Neither actual lent amounts nor lending-income allocation are established here. This is not a finding that lending is currently occurring.

actors.name: Security Agent Services AG
actors.alignment: Analysis: paying enforcement costs before holders supports recovery work, but those costs can reduce the amount holders ultimately recover.
actors.tradeoff: The review establishes payment priority, not a rate, fixed-fee contract or independence from the issuer.

actors.name: Liquidity venues (not identified)
actors.alignment: Analysis: secondary execution can involve separate venue economics.
actors.tradeoff: No venue fee is confirmed here.

gaps: No FGDLx-specific fee is confirmed by the TSLAx page.
Current parent-support commitments, cash runway and profitability are not established.
No current all-in fee or score is calculated.

profiles.name: PreStocks
profiles.summary: Observed mints had a 100 bps transfer-fee configuration in epoch 1039. The authority that can set or withdraw fees is not evidence of the legal beneficiary.

fees.label: Observed Token-2022 transfer fee
fees.payer: Deducted from the transferred amount; economic burden depends on the route

scope.holder: Eight mints covered by the saved observation

fees.note: Fee configuration observed at epoch 1039, not a fresh transaction simulation. Maximum raw fee is u64 max (18446744073709551615); legal beneficiary is unknown. Do not infer this observation for newly issued mints.

fees.label: Redemption conditions permit acquisition, management, performance and selling costs
fees.payer: Redeeming holder under the stated conditions
fees.note: These are permitted pro-rata cost categories in the redemption conditions, not quantified current charges or proof of a recurring holding fee.

actors.name: PreStocks
actors.alignment: Analysis, not an intent claim: changeable fee categories can support programme operations while reducing a holder's net proceeds.
actors.tradeoff: A current issuer fee and recipient are not quantified.

actors.name: Shared multisig transfer-fee authority
actors.alignment: Analysis, not an intent claim: observed authority can configure and withdraw transfer fees.
actors.tradeoff: Authority does not identify the legal beneficiary.

gaps: Legal payee of observed transfer fees is unknown.
No current terms-based fee amount is confirmed.
This does not identify every actor or beneficiary.
